## Findings

### SchedulingGateway Interface Analysis
- File: `apps/ai-orchestrator/src/modules/scheduling-service/client.ts`
- Confirmed: No import-related methods exist
- Methods available: listActiveServices, findService, getAvailableSlotsForServices, createAppointment, findFutureAppointmentsForPhone/Customer, findCustomerCandidatesByPhone, getAuthorizedCustomerContext, cancelAppointment, rescheduleAppointment, createHold, releaseHold, previewAppointmentSeries, confirmAppointmentSeries
- Status: COMPLIANT - No import methods

### AssistantToolRegistry Analysis  
- File: `apps/ai-orchestrator/src/modules/tools/assistant-tools.ts`
- Tools registered: list_services, get_availability, create_appointment, cancel_appointment, reschedule_appointment, prepare_recurring_appointments, confirm_recurring_appointments, list_customer_candidates, get_customer_context, search_business_knowledge
- Status: COMPLIANT - No import tools

### Import Routes Verification
- File: `apps/scheduling-service/src/modules/internal-api/routes.ts`
- Routes: POST/GET `/internal/calendar/imports/*` (start, analyze, execute, complete, progress, etc.)
- Protection: All routes require `requireHumanCaller(context)` which blocks IA access
- Status: COMPLIANT - Already protected from IA

Test design created but file write blocked by permissions.
